pillars: 1. Algebraic Geometry, Resolution of Singularities, Arakelov Heights & Abelian Moduli

Covers the algebraic-geometric and arithmetic-intersection backbone implemented in `Development.AbelianVarietyTheory` (`8,142,960` lines) and `Development.ResolutionOfSingularities` (`140,709` lines).
Covers the integral and rational $p$-adic Hodge machinery in `GroundTheory.PAdicHodge` and `AbelianVarietyTheory.Proofs.InertiaEigenvalues`.
3. Theta Correspondence, Weil Representation, Siegel-Weil Formula & Rallis Inner Product (1 Inactive Slot Included)
Supports Acts 3 and 4 ($\sqrt{X}$-iterated theta lifts and seesaw cancellation). Entry `#144` (`L505`) is a refactored `Prop := True` placeholder slot (`UnusedSlot72`).
4. Local and Real Representation Theory of $\mathrm{GL}_n$, Reductive & Unitary Groups
Covers $p$-adic Bernstein-Zelevinsky classification, Moy-Prasad depth-`0` theory, and real Harish-Chandra discrete series.
5. Global Automorphic Spectrum, Base Change & Langlands-Galois Correspondence
Covers local/global Langlands correspondences, Galois representations in Shimura cohomology, cyclic base change, and rapid/Sobolev cusp-form decay.
6. Class Field Theory, Galois Cohomology, Complex Multiplication (CM) & $L$-Function Foundations
Covers Artin reciprocity, Poitou-Tate duality, the Greenberg-Wiles formula, Shimura-Taniyama CM theory, and analytic continuation of Hecke $L$-functions.
7. Top-Level Hypothesis Assemblers (9 Bundles) & Master Join Theorem (`L589`..`L810`)
Packages the `185` individual literature wrappers into domain records and joins them with the novel automorphic window theorem (`VWin`).
